description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with Git to determine changed files and changed extensions within a repository, specifically for managing plugin extensions. It includes functions for listing available extensions, detecting changed extensions based on Git diffs, and resolving base commits.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with specified arguments and options, returning the command output.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a file path to a normalized form with forward slashes.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks if a given ref (commit hash or branch) exists in the local git repository.

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Determines the appropriate base commit for diffing based on provided parameters and git repository state.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of file paths changed between the base revision and the head revision.

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Checks if a particular extension directory has a package.json file, indicating it's a valid extension.

methods.name: listAvailableExtensionIds
methods.description: Lists all extension IDs for which a package.json exists in the bundled plugin directory.

methods.name: detectChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Detects extension IDs that have changed based on a list of changed file paths.

methods.name: listChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Main exported function to list extension IDs that have changed based on git diff and parameters.
